title: Fortune Head GSSP (base of the Cambrian)
summary: Fortune Head, on the Burin Peninsula of southeastern Newfoundland, hosts the global reference point for the base of the Cambrian System. The boundary is placed at the first appearance of the trace fossil Treptichnus (Trichophycus) pedum, and was designated in 1992. The International Commission on Stratigraphy lists its age as 538.8 ± 0.6 Ma.

uncertainty.note: ICS age 538.8 ± 0.6 Ma for the boundary; the GSSP was ratified in 1992.

importance.justification: The formally designated global reference section for the base of the Cambrian, the start of the Phanerozoic.
